mobile-sampling-numeric-v1.cause_and_correction: Cube arithmetic found shared-divider subnormal normalization and underflow rounding defects; corrected production divider passes rational and cube regressions.

mobile-sampling-composed-v1.cause_and_correction: Test GXL1 fixture misplaced high words of 33-bit pitches; corrected explicit independent encoding passes all four targets.

mobile-sampling-admission-v3.cause_and_correction: Late-fault fixture waited for a reply after consumption. Record accepted response addresses instead; focused rerun and fresh final suite pass.

lod_static_slice_width.cause_and_correction: Static right shifts reduce Chisel widths; the first fixed-slice refactor selected unavailable high bits. Explicit zero extension fixes elaboration. Fresh final 107-test aggregate passes.

limits: Internal endpoint consumes an explicit effective FP32 lambda; native floating packet/instruction transport, shader bias, gradient and implicit quad/helper LOD remain open.
One request owns serialized admission, cube arithmetic, tap fetching and reused FMA filtering; no texture-cluster throughput claim.
Parent pins publication and address translation until retirement and explicitly invalidates on rebinding. No new software capability is advertised.
Banked texture caches, miss joining, coherence, broader integration and the original H0-H8 requirements remain open.
Cube double-border corners select one available current-face corner texel as permitted by GLES3.
Synthesis only; no routing, power, whole-GPU clock or frame-rate closure.

initial_synthesis_failure.cause_and_correction: Combinational request lambda through both FP32 clamps, significand splitting, fraction normalization and mip choice missed setup. Register these operations separately and use fixed slices for the four uncapped integer exponents. Preserve clamp, rounding and filter semantics at the original 1000ps constraint.

second_synthesis_failure.cause_and_correction: LOD register cuts move the failing path to array-layer conversion. Split guard extraction, integer rounding and layer-count saturation across registers. Supplemental STA also finds a -3.147ps periodic-wrap path; exploit the proven [-1,2N] bounds to select wrap endpoints and compute one parallel subtraction, preserving seven-cycle axis latency.

supplemental_STA.scope: Additional paths on the immutable V2 mapped design; canonical synthesis reports unchanged. Finds the -3.147ps wrap path after the primary -136.698ps layer path.
